TX.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Statewide Expunction Project
TX.what_they_offer: Helps clear eligible criminal records through expunctions and nondisclosure orders via direct representation, recurring virtual clinics, and library outreach events.
TX.who_qualifies: Financially eligible residents within their North Texas and Panhandle service area (income at or below 200% of the federal poverty guidelines).

TX.name: ClearPath Texas
TX.what_they_offer: Coordinates free in-person, remote, and live-chat expunction and nondisclosure clinics connecting residents with legal aid attorneys across Texas.
TX.who_qualifies: Income-eligible Texans whose cases were dismissed, resulted in acquittal, or completed deferred adjudication for certain offenses.

TX.name: Texas State Law Library
TX.what_they_offer: Provides self-help legal guides explaining Texas expunction, adult nondisclosure, and juvenile record sealing laws along with links to common court forms.

TX.name: Lone Star Legal Aid - Civil Matters in Criminal Justice Project
TX.what_they_offer: Provides civil legal representation to file applications for expungements and nondisclosure orders, repair inaccurate background checks, and access criminal records.
TX.who_qualifies: Residents in their East Texas and Houston service area whose income is at or below 125% of the Federal Poverty Line.

TX.name: University of Texas School of Law - Expunction Project
TX.what_they_offer: Pro bono law school program with intakes in September and February that helps determine eligibility and prepare court paperwork to expunge or seal criminal records.
TX.who_qualifies: People who cannot afford to hire an attorney.

TX.name: Texas Fair Defense Project
TX.what_they_offer: Provides legal assistance to seal or destroy eligible Texas criminal records through nondisclosures and expunctions; note that intake is currently closed to new applicants.
TX.who_qualifies: Applicants entitled to record clearing under Texas law whose income is within 200% of the federal poverty guidelines and who submit a DPS Criminal History Report.

TX.name: Justice Reform Foundation - Expungement Program
TX.what_they_offer: Screens criminal records, prepares expunction or nondisclosure petitions with supervised law students, and files petitions with the court.
TX.who_qualifies: Texans with qualifying dismissed charges, acquittals, uncharged arrests, certain Class C misdemeanors, or completed deferred adjudications who could not otherwise afford legal help.

TX.name: University of Houston Law Center - Records Sealing and Expunction Clinic
TX.what_they_offer: Law school clinic where students assist clients with juvenile records sealing, adult criminal record expunctions, and adult nondisclosure orders.

TX.name: Texas A&M University School of Law - Criminal Defense Clinic
TX.area_served: Tarrant County and statewide via JRF Expungement Program
TX.what_they_offer: Student interns screen records and prepare expunction and nondisclosure petitions in partnership with the Justice Reform Foundation.
TX.who_qualifies: Eligible Texans who cannot afford legal representation.

TX.name: Texas Legal Services Center
TX.what_they_offer: Provides free legal assistance to help Texans seal or expunge eligible criminal records.
TX.who_qualifies: Generally requires applicants to meet income guidelines.

TX.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid
TX.area_served: Central & West Texas, Rio Grande Valley
TX.what_they_offer: Legal aid organization providing free legal assistance with criminal record sealing and expunctions.
TX.who_qualifies: Income-eligible residents living within their Central Texas, West Texas, and Rio Grande Valley service area.

TX.name: Travis County Law Library
TX.what_they_offer: Listed resource offering free assistance with criminal record sealing and expunctions.

TX.name: Volunteer Legal Services of Central Texas
TX.what_they_offer: Offers free legal assistance with record sealing and expunctions, including monthly in-person legal advice clinics by appointment.
TX.who_qualifies: Residents of Travis, Hays, Bastrop, and Williamson counties who meet income eligibility requirements.

TX.name: Jefferson County Bar Association Pro Bono Program
TX.what_they_offer: Provides pro bono legal assistance for criminal record sealing and expunctions in Southeast Texas.
TX.who_qualifies: Qualifying residents of Jefferson, Hardin, and Orange counties.

TX.name: Dallas Volunteer Attorney Program
TX.what_they_offer: Provides free legal help and ongoing in-person legal clinics for criminal record sealing and expunctions.
TX.who_qualifies: Residents in the Dallas area meeting program income and service area requirements.

TX.name: Unlocking Doors
TX.area_served: Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman, Rockwall, Tarrant, and Ellis counties
TX.what_they_offer: Assists individuals in the Dallas and Fort Worth areas (in partnership with Cornerstone Assistance Center in Fort Worth) with record sealing and expunction services.
TX.who_qualifies: Qualifying residents of Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman, Rockwall, Tarrant, and Ellis counties.
